svg.text: A239 -- the gear lemma on rings below 4: (D) the wall-to-wall contact ring at S = 3.95 (k = 0, theta* = 33.8 deg), (D') the jutting third member (k = 1) and the pocket it kills, (E) corner swap + shrink of the S = 3.90 ring, (E') its flush end
fits
(D) WHAT IT IS: the window ring (A237 family, eta = 0: real contacts) at S = 3.95 at the tilt theta* = 33.79
deg where the reach closes: at every corner a flat meeter (offset delta = 0.576) and a tilted partner
resting on its corner and on the wall; every wall spanned in CONTACT by one flat and one tilted meeter (k =
ring: 8 squares, pattern 2 2 2 2 (meeters per corner BL BR TR TL), 20 contact rows; free FJ LP (walls +
contacts, no floor, no crowd rows): INFEASIBLE; minimal external load closing the balance: 1.000; with every
PUSH loaded >= 0.1: 1.042; torque-only: infeasible (the forces cannot close around the ring).
RED = the deficit rows drawn at the squares that need them (external force at the centre, torque as an arc): 1:
torque only + anti-aligning torque +0.067; 2: into right; 3: along floor toward corner + anti-aligning
torque +0.063; 5: along right toward corner + anti-aligning torque +0.131; 7: torque only + anti-aligning
torque +0.100.
pocket: area 7.603, coverable <= 2.411, waste >= 5.191 (hatched); greedy capacity 1 (the stipple square);
PIERCE(1) at the centre residual 0.0e+00 => capacity 1; members an interior square can touch: ['1', '3',
checks: packing True (min pair gap -4.4e-16, min wall -4.4e-16; contacts at 0); times: check 0.00 s, LP 0.01 s,
capacity 0.3 s, waste 0.1 s, pierce 0.0 s, touchable 0.2 s; draw 0.08 s.
GEAR LEMMA: the load enters a crowd along the flat meeter's wall and leaves along the other wall through the
corner-on-edge contact at angle theta: F_out = cot(theta) F_in (rings_below_4.md s.3), so the loop gain is
cot^4(theta*) = 4.99 != 1 and NO force balance closes around the ring (torque-only infeasible); torque
balance of a tilted meeter under its three contacts needs the partner's corner at cos^2 theta along its
edge, i.e. delta = sin th + cos^3 th = 1.130 > 1: impossible in the box.
What would move: with the PUSHes loaded and nothing from outside, every tilted meeter turns TOWARD alignment
(Lemma W's sense, the red arcs are the anti-aligning torques it lacks) and every flat meeter slides along
its wall AWAY from its corner (the red arrows are the corner-ward holders it lacks): the crowd settles --
the DRAIN. An interior square could supply one holder only by touching a member; the pocket holds ONE
square (grey), which can touch the tilted meeters (['1', '3', '5', '7']) but cannot hold four corners: 8 + 1
(D') WHAT IT IS: the JUTTING variant: the window ring at theta = 10 deg (walls NOT in contact: floor gap 0.601
< 1, the reach falls short of s - 2), plus a third member M (blue, 45 deg) resting as low as it goes on the
two tilted meeters beside the floor gap -- the k = 1 holder that closes the floor chain (contacts [1, 3]).
ring: 9 squares, pattern 2 2 2 2 (meeters per corner BL BR TR TL), 18 contact rows; free FJ LP (walls +
contacts, no floor, no crowd rows): INFEASIBLE; minimal external load closing the balance: 1.000; with every
PUSH loaded >= 0.1: 1.452; torque-only: infeasible (the forces cannot close around the ring).
RED = the deficit rows drawn at the squares that need them (external force at the centre, torque as an arc): 0:
along floor toward corner; 1: along left toward corner + anti-aligning torque +0.055; 2: along right toward
corner; 3: along floor toward corner + anti-aligning torque +0.055; 4: into ceil; 5: along right toward
corner + anti-aligning torque +0.055; 6: along left toward corner; 7: along ceil toward corner +
anti-aligning torque +0.055.
pocket: area 6.603, coverable <= 0.000, waste >= 6.603 (hatched); greedy capacity 0 (the stipple square);
PIERCE(1) at the centre residual 0.0e+00 => capacity 1; members an interior square can touch: [].
checks: packing True (min pair gap -6.4e-15, min wall 0.0e+00; contacts at 0); times: check 0.00 s, LP 0.01 s,
capacity 0.1 s, waste 0.1 s, pierce 0.0 s, touchable 0.2 s; draw 0.05 s.
The jut reaches y = 2.38 > S/2: the pocket left is EMPTY -- the eroded free-centre region is empty in every
1-deg tilt bin (rigorous, A237's kernel sandwich), so no unit square fits and no second jut (the ceiling's 3
2 3 2 pattern) has room: this ring closes at 9 < 11. With the PUSHes loaded the deficit is again
anti-aligning torques on the tilted meeters and corner-ward holders on the flat ones (red); M supplies one
holder pair and nothing can supply the rest.
(E) WHAT IT IS: the CLICK / SWAP on the S = 3.90 ring (A231's improvement): the ring + its one interior square
is a 9-square packing; CORNER-SWAP at BL (ring_swap.md s.2.1): the two meeters out, the slot square in
(blue, pinned), the leftover re-placed by the region search (Lemma SWAP: same side 3.90); then the SHRINK --
the fixed-tilt side LP of Lemma GRAIN-LP with the slot pinned, axes re-selected: side 3.0198 (inner frame;
12 LP rounds, 0.04 s).
The anchored move (the three remaining tilted squares rotate to alignment in 20 steps, LP at each): 3.020 3.015
3.010 3.005 3.000 -> 3.0000 = the 3 x 3 grid (E'); the plain click of the unswapped 9-ring reaches 3.0000 as
well and the 8-ring 3.0000: below 4 the crowd ring is a rattler structure whose side is set by nothing.
checks: packing True (gap -4.4e-16, wall -6.1e-18); swap 0.09 s, move 0.60 s.
(E') WHAT IT IS: the end of the anchored move: every square flat, the slot square still pinned at BL, side
3.0000 -- the trivial 3 x 3 packing of the 9 squares (Lemma FLUSH: a flush packing of 9 needs side >= 3,
attained). For 11 squares the same ring has no room for the missing three (capacity 1), which is why no
11-square four-crowd below 4 exists to click (A217: the lowest is 4.0014).
checks: packing True (min pair gap 0.0e+00, min wall 0.0e+00).
